all.name: Daredevil
all.description: A tragic accident transformed Matt Murdock, blinding him, but awakening his incredible Radar Sense. When darkness falls, Daredevil wields his billy clubs in place of a gavel, doling out justice and purging the world of evil!

item.name: Devil Strike
item.description: Rapidly strike enemies using boxing techniques. Gain Fury on hit.

item.name: Justice Jab
item.description: Swing Billy Clubs forward. Gain <Orange>Fury</> on hit.

item.name: Objection!
item.description: Whirl billy clubs in a tight guard to block frontal damage and reflect <Orange>projectiles</>, becoming immune to all incoming harm during this stance and gain <Orange>Fury</>.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: Block frontal damage and reflect projectiles, becoming immune to all incoming harm during this stance. Gain 60 Fury when successfully blocking an attack.

item.name: Devil's Latch
item.description: Fire a grappling line that reels Daredevil and his target toward each other. On completion, gain <Orange>Fury</> and temporarily enables <Orange>Righteous Cross</>.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: Enable Righteous Cross within 5 seconds after using this ability. Gain 30 Fury

item.name: Righteous Cross
item.description: Cross Billy Clubs and surge forward. Gain <Orange>Fury</> on hit.

item.name: Infernal Fury
item.description: Consume <Orange>Fury</> to unleash either <Orange>Devil's Chain</> or <Orange>Devil's Throw</>. <Orange>Devil's Chain</> converts damage dealt into <Buff>Bonus Health</>; <Orange>Devil's Throw</> <Debuff>Slows</> hit targets. Both temporarily enable <Orange>Righteous Cross</>.

additional_fields.Damage: 40. Cause 75 damage when the target caught in the high damage range
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Devil's Throw slows enemies on hit
additional_fields.Spell_Field_Range: Box shaped spell field. Length: 8m; Width: 4m; Height: 4m
additional_fields.Bonus_Health_Falloff: Falloff begins at 5s and decreases by 30/s
additional_fields.Max_Number_of_Ricochets: 4. Up to 2 ricochets if there are no targets
additional_fields.High_Damage_Spell_Field_Range: 2m spherical radius spell field at the end

item.name: Devil's Chain
item.description: Swing both Billy Clubs while grappling, then slam downward to deal damage. Hitting enemies grants a larger amount of Bonus Health.

item.name: Devil's Throw
item.description: Retract the grappling cord, then throw both Billy Clubs in succession. Billy Clubs ricochet between enemies, granting a small amount of Bonus Health with each hit.

item.name: Let The Devil Out
item.description: Embrace the Beast within. Enemies with Daredevil in their line of sight take damage and suffer a ramping <Debuff>Blind</> effect. Continually gain <Orange>Fury</> while active.

additional_fields.Damage: 50/s. Cause 85 damage per second when reaching the max damage
additional_fields.Blind_Effect: Visual range 35m, decreasing to 10m when the Blind effect reaches its maximum

item.name: Blind Verdict
item.description: Daredevil shares the location of his <Orange>Sonic Pursuit</> target with The Punisher. At the same time, The Punisher can launch a devil-infused shock grenade to damage and <Debuff>Blind</> enemies.
